title: Spanish Team Tests a Simple Way to Get Oil From Coffee Grounds
paragraphs: Many people drink coffee every day. After we make coffee, we throw away the used grounds. The world makes a lot of this waste.
Scientists in Spain found a use for it. Coffee grounds have some oil inside. The oil can make biodiesel, a fuel for engines.
The team tested a simple method. They used a warm liquid, 45 degrees, for one hour. The method got about 90 percent of the oil. It is a lab test, not a factory yet.

questions.q: What do people throw away after making coffee?
Is the method in a factory yet?
questions.a: No, it is only a lab test.
